system.description:
Unlucky: -1 Core Skill Point in Luck while the amulet is in your possession. Spirit Talker: while you wear it, you can see and talk to ghosts and beings on the astral plane.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.156
system.summary: Unlucky: -1 Core Skill Point in Luck while the amulet is in your possession. Spirit Talker: while you wear it, you can see and talk to ghosts and beings on the astral plane.

automation.note: Unlucky applies whenever you carry the amulet, worn or not, so keep it equipped on the sheet. Spirit Talker only works while you actually wear it.
